# Patterns that must never appear on the public main branch.
# One extended-regex pattern per line, matched against each added/modified
# file path in a push or PR. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# These correspond 1:1 to what was moved to retail-marketing-skills-private
# on 2026-08-28. If you're intentionally adding a new private/paid-tier file
# that should stay out of this repo, add its exact pattern here instead of
# committing it here "just this once."

^PRIVATE_REPO_ACCESS_MODEL\.md$
^TEMPLATE_PACKAGE_.*\.md$
^UPDATE_AUTOMATION\.md$
^EVALUATION_SUMMARY\.md$
^EVALUATION_COMPLETED_SUMMARY\.md$
^SKILL_UPDATES_SUMMARY\.md$
^KNOWLEDGE_INTEGRATION_SUMMARY\.md$
^SKILL_IMPROVEMENT_PRIORITIZATION\.md$
^SUBSTACK_.*\.md$
^REVIEW\.md$
^ROADMAP\.md$
^memory\.md$
^src/
^routines/
^scripts/(batch_lead_enricher\.py|bulk_ad_generator\.js)$

# Completed evaluations (real dates, "-sample-", "-example-", or "-update"
# in the name) are private proof-of-ROI content. Blank fill-in-the-blank
# templates (e.g. evaluations/ads-skill-eval.md) are meant to stay public —
# this pattern only matches the filled-in ones.
^evaluations/.*(20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|-sample|-example|-update)\.md$
